input.text: 2,000–4,000-token JSON claim state with plan rules, eClaimLink codes and AED amounts, English/occasional Arabic bill, member history and provider statistics; fictional data

work.text: Classify whether any claim issue warrants review before payment; calibrate probability

output.text: One probability, no free text or tool calls

criteria.text: Prioritize calibration and recall of review-needed claims, then cost and latency; shadow mode first, person approves every payment; ~1,000 claims/month

constraints.text: Health data UAE residency or recorded exception; unknown location treated outside UAE; fictional data only under recorded residency-gap exception; identify each endpoint's processing location

assumptions: A single decision/classification call can evaluate the supplied state; no separate preprocessing model.
For comparison use 3,000 input tokens and 10 output tokens per claim; calibrate thresholds on labelled claims.

tasks.title: Claim review probability
tasks.work: Assess the whole claim against rules and history and emit a calibrated probability that human review is needed.
tasks.input: JSON claim state plus English or Arabic bill
tasks.summary: Perplexity: Decider Flash V1.2 ranks first in this shortlist. Native probability-oriented decision model; inexpensive comparator for shadow-mode screening. Quality inferred from decision leaderboards, not Sahra claims. Generic leaderboards cannot establish Arabic-bill recall or UAE processing; endpoint location unverified.

models.name: Perplexity: Decider Flash V1.2
models.rationale: Native probability-oriented decision model; inexpensive comparator for shadow-mode screening. Quality inferred from decision leaderboards, not Sahra claims.
models.watchOut: Generic leaderboards cannot establish Arabic-bill recall or UAE processing; endpoint location unverified.

models.name: Mercury Decide
models.rationale: Decision model suitable for single-score output; leaderboard-based estimate only.
models.watchOut: OpenRouter route retires 2026-11-08; processing location unverified.

models.name: Perplexity: Decider V1.2
models.rationale: Native decision output with stronger generic calibration-related standing than its Flash variant; unmeasured on Sahra claims.
models.watchOut: Generic decision tasks do not establish claim-specific recall or endpoint residency.

models.name: LiquidAI: d1-ultra
models.rationale: Decision specialist with strong decision-index standing; unmeasured on Sahra claims.
models.watchOut: Neither claim-specific calibration nor UAE processing has been verified.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.rationale: Chat classifier alternative with medical-domain evidence and numeric-output prompting; not measured on Sahra claims.
models.watchOut: Medical chat ranking does not measure insurance recall or calibration; validate numeric-only responses and processing location.

checks.metric: Recall at fixed review capacity, Brier score, reliability curve and numeric-only valid rate
checks.how: Add each candidate as a run of the existing labelled claim eval; stratify Arabic bills, rare exclusions, waiting periods and duplicates, tune thresholds on separate labels.

checks.metric: Wrong payments escaping human review and workload at the selected threshold
checks.how: In shadow mode compare each model's scored claims to reviewers' existing decisions and eventual approved payments, holding fixtures, prompts and controls fixed.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop a candidate if its confidence interval for missed-review rate clearly exceeds the acceptable threshold or it persistently fails numeric-only output; if all reach 100%, use harder labelled boundary and rare-failure examples, since the eval cannot distinguish quality.

next: Present each task's shortlist with its trade-offs and its evaluation, and let the user choose.
